plan.title: eRFX RFQ counter offer accepted before award

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ Responses screen containing Vendor A's own bid.
Send the buyer's counter offer of 90 on Vendor A's normal bid.
Verify the Responses grid marks the counter offer as initiated for Vendor A.
Use the vendor portal session to accept Vendor A's pending counter offer.
Verify the buyer-side Responses grid marks Vendor A's counter offer as accepted.
Open the buyer's Master QCS to inspect the post-acceptance bid.
Assert that Master QCS shows the accepted counter-offer price of 90 for Vendor A.
